newsitem.title: USA: Regency nets additional $6 mln in shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Regency nets additional $6 mln in shr offer.

text.p: Regency Realty Corp said Friday it netted about $6.0 million by selling an additional 226,000 shares for $27.25 a share following an earlier 4.2 million share offering.
The integrated real estate company netted a total of $121 million in the offering, including the additional $6 million, a Regency spokesman said in an interview.

The company said underwriters led by Prudential Securities used their over-allotment option of 130,000 shares and Security Capital U.S. Realty simultaneously bought 96,000 shares. Regency added it will use the proceeds to pay off debt.

The company completed the 2.4 million share offering and the simultaneous sale of 1.8 million shares to Security Capital for $27.25 per share July 11. Regency now has 22.2 million common shares outstanding, the spokesman said.
Regency's stock traded at $27-1/8 Friday morning, down 5/16.
